data.message: Heading to medbay for scan.

I found Charlie’s body in Storage, right near the middle/left side of the room. I reported immediately.

My route was Cafeteria → Electrical → Medbay → Upper Engine → Lower Engine → Storage. I saw Frank in Medbay around tick 7, then Frank went into Upper Engine from Medbay around tick 9. I also saw Alice in Upper Engine around ticks 9-10, and Alice left Upper Engine toward Medbay at tick 11.

I didn’t see anyone in Storage when I got there besides Charlie’s body, so I don’t know who killed. Just giving my path and sightings for now.

I started in Storage, then went Storage → Lower Engine → Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical. I did not see Charlie or any body in Storage when I was there at the start.

In Upper Engine around tick 9, I saw both Eve and Frank enter from Medbay. Eve stayed around Upper Engine through about tick 11, and I saw Frank there at tick 9 too. Then I left toward Medbay and ended up in Electrical when the report happened.

So from my side, the body must have happened in Storage after I left. I can confirm Eve’s sighting of me in Upper Engine, and I also confirm Frank came into Upper Engine from Medbay around the same time as Eve. I don’t have a hard accusation yet — I didn’t see Bob or Diana at all this round.

My route was Navigation → Storage → Medbay → Upper Engine → Oxygen, where I was when the meeting got called.

Important info: I saw Diana enter Storage from Medbay around tick 7. I did not see a body there then. After that I went to Medbay and saw Charlie alive in Medbay at ticks 9, 10, and 11. So Charlie definitely died after tick 11, and the body ended up in Storage after that.

I didn’t see Alice, Eve, or Frank myself this round, only Diana in Storage and Charlie alive in Medbay. Diana’s tick 7 Storage sighting is probably too early to be the kill if Charlie was alive at 11, but I’d like to hear where Diana went after Storage. Also anyone who was near Medbay/Storage after tick 11 is more relevant. I don’t have a hard accusation yet.

My route was Electrical → Medbay → Storage → Navigation → Security, and I was in Security when the report happened.

I can confirm Bob’s part about seeing me in Storage around tick 7 — I saw Bob there too. I did not see a body in Storage then, and I never saw Charlie this round. After Storage I went away to Navigation, then Security, so I wasn’t near Storage/Medbay late.

If Bob is telling the truth that Charlie was alive in Medbay at ticks 9-11, then the kill is definitely after that, which makes my tick 7 Storage sighting irrelevant for the kill. The more important area is Medbay/Storage after tick 11. Alice says she went Upper Engine → Medbay → Electrical around then, but didn’t mention seeing Charlie in Medbay, while Bob says Charlie was there. That timing is something I want clarified.

Eve found the body, but her route through Upper/Lower to Storage also puts her near the report location late. Frank was around Medbay/Upper too and hasn’t spoken yet, so I really want to hear Frank’s route before voting. Right now I’m most suspicious of whoever was around Medbay/Storage after tick 11, not Bob’s early Storage sighting of me.

"I can confirm the early game sightings. My path was Oxygen -> Upper Engine -> Medbay -> Upper Engine, and I definitely saw both Alice and Eve in Upper Engine around tick 9. 

After that, I went down to Lower Engine to do my task, and then turned around to head back to Upper Engine. I was never in Storage this round.

Diana's logic is spot on. If Bob saw Charlie alive in Medbay at ticks 9 through 11, Charlie must have headed down to Storage right after that. Alice, it's a bit odd you didn't see Charlie when you entered Medbay at 11, but maybe you just narrowly missed him as he left.

But look very closely at Eve's route. Eve went Upper Engine -> Lower Engine -> Storage. That path essentially trails right into Storage at the exact time Charlie would have arrived there from Medbay. Eve, you were the only one who ended up exactly where Charlie died, right at the time of death. Finding the body there and having no other suspects is extremely convenient. 

To me, this strongly looks like a self-report by Eve. The timeline perfectly aligns with her catching up to Charlie. I'm voting Eve."

eve

I want to push back on Frank’s accusation. Yes, I was the reporter and yes, I arrived in Storage late — I’m not hiding that. But I reported immediately because Charlie was already dead there when I walked in.

My confirmed sightings are: Frank in Medbay tick 7, then Frank entering Upper Engine from Medbay at tick 9. Alice was in Upper Engine ticks 9-10 and left toward Medbay at tick 11. I then went Upper Engine → Lower Engine → Storage and found Charlie.

The key issue is that Frank’s “I was never in Storage” is completely unconfirmed after tick 9. From Upper Engine, he could go to Lower Engine and then Storage just like I did. He says he turned around, but no one has confirmed that. Also, he’s making a very hard self-report accusation when the same route/timing could apply to him.

I agree the kill is likely after Bob saw Charlie alive in Medbay around ticks 9-11. That puts suspicion on anyone near Medbay/Lower/Storage late: me, Frank, and maybe Alice depending on timing. I know it wasn’t me, so Frank’s hard push feels opportunistic to me.

I want to clarify my timing: I left Upper Engine toward Medbay around tick 11, but I did **not** see Charlie in Medbay when I passed through, and I also didn’t see Bob or Diana at all. So either Charlie had just left toward Storage before I got there, or Bob’s timing is slightly off.

What I can confirm strongly is that Eve and Frank both came into Upper Engine from Medbay at tick 9, and I saw Eve still in Upper Engine through tick 11. Frank was there at tick 9, but after that I can’t confirm where he went.

Based on the timeline, the kill had to be late, after Charlie was alive in Medbay. That makes the possible routes to Storage really important. Eve admits she went Upper → Lower → Storage and found the body, so she definitely had opportunity. But Frank also could have gone Upper → Lower → Storage, and his “I turned around” part is not confirmed by anyone. His hard push on Eve could be correct, but it could also be him trying to frame the reporter.

Right now I’m between Eve and Frank. I don’t think Diana’s early Storage visit matters much, and I don’t have enough on Bob unless his Charlie timing is wrong.

I want to restate my key info because it anchors the timeline: I’m confident Charlie was alive in Medbay at ticks 9, 10, and 11. So the Storage kill is late — after tick 11.

Alice not seeing Charlie when she passed Medbay doesn’t feel like a big contradiction to me. If Charlie left Medbay toward Storage right after I saw him, Alice could easily have just missed him.

That makes Diana’s early Storage visit basically irrelevant to the kill, and I’m not really suspicious of Diana from what I saw.

For me the suspect pool is mainly Eve and Frank. Eve is confirmed going Upper → Lower → Storage and reported the body, so she had direct opportunity. But Frank’s late route is also unconfirmed: he was in Upper, says he went Lower then turned back, but nobody can verify he didn’t continue into Storage. His hard push on Eve could be right, or it could be a frame.

I’m leaning slightly Eve because she’s the one confirmed at the body on the exact late route, but I don’t think Frank is cleared at all.

My info hasn’t changed: I was Electrical → Medbay → Storage → Navigation → Security. I saw Bob in Storage around tick 7, no body, and I never saw Charlie. I was far from Storage late, so I don’t think my route fits the kill timing if Bob’s Medbay sighting is accurate.

I agree the case is basically Eve vs Frank. Alice’s missed Charlie timing is plausible if Charlie just left Medbay, and Bob’s info feels consistent to me.

Between Eve and Frank, Eve is the only one confirmed to end up at the body on the exact late route, but Frank’s “I turned around” after Lower Engine is totally unconfirmed, and his hard push on Eve could be a duck trying to frame the reporter.

I’m not 100% certain, but I’m still leaning Eve slightly on opportunity. Frank is my next suspect if Eve isn’t it.

"I understand why Alice, Bob, and Diana are keeping me in the suspect pool. It’s true that from Upper Engine, my path *could* have gone down to Storage just like Eve's did. 

But I want to remind everyone of the key difference here: Eve actually admits to walking right into Storage at the exact moment Charlie would have arrived there from Medbay, based on Bob's timeline. She is the only one confirmed to be standing over the body. 

Eve says my push is opportunistic, but I'm just looking at the facts Bob and Alice laid out. Charlie was alive in Medbay at 11, he heads to Storage. Eve trails right behind him through Lower Engine and 'finds' him dead? It's textbook self-reporting. She knew Charlie had just been seen alive, so she couldn't claim it was an old body, and she had to report it before someone else walked in.

Let’s not overthink this and let a self-reporter slip away by casting doubt on unconfirmed routes. The simplest answer is the right one here. I’m voting Eve."

I called this because Diana’s body is in security. My route this round was electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria. I saw Diana alive in weapons at tick 27, so this kill is very recent. Earlier I saw Eve and Frank in upper engine around ticks 9-11, but Eve is already out. I did not see Bob at all this round. Frank, I need your route, and Bob, same — someone had to get Diana from weapons/security very late.

Alice is spot on about the early game — we definitely crossed paths around upper engine. My route for the second half of this round was medbay -> electrical, and I literally just walked into weapons right before the meeting was called. 

Here's the kicker: Bob was already in weapons with me when the bell rang. If Alice saw Diana in weapons at tick 27, and she ended up dead in security right after, Bob had the perfect positioning to do it and walk right back to weapons. I didn't see Diana at all on my way up. Since Alice and I can vouch for each other's early locations, Bob is the only one completely unaccounted for during that time. It has to be Bob. I'm voting him.

My route was medbay -> upper engine -> oxygen -> cafeteria -> weapons. I saw Diana way earlier in storage at tick 7, and Charlie alive in medbay around ticks 9-11 before the first meeting. This round I did not go into security at all.

The key thing: at tick 29, Frank entered weapons from security. I was already in weapons when he came in. If Diana’s body is in security and the kill was recent, Frank literally came from the body location right before the meeting. Him saying I had “perfect positioning” is backwards — he’s the one I saw coming out of security.

Alice, if you saw Diana alive in weapons at tick 27, then someone killed her in/near security right after. Frank is the only person I directly saw exiting security at the end. I think Frank is hard accusing me because I’m the only witness to that.

I’m leaning Frank here.

Bob’s detail that Frank entered weapons from security at tick 29 matters a lot, because Diana’s body was in security and I saw Diana alive in weapons at tick 27. That’s a very tight window. Frank’s route explanation also kind of skips over the fact that he would have had to pass through security to reach weapons from electrical.

I don’t have Bob visually cleared, but I also never saw Bob this round, and Frank was the one both near the route and directly called out as coming from the body location. With 3 alive, we have to vote correctly. My vote is Frank.
Bob

It’s Frank. I’m the only one who actually saw the end movement: at tick 29, Frank entered weapons from security, and Alice found Diana’s body in security right after. Diana was alive in weapons at tick 27, so the kill window is basically right then.

Frank’s story tries to frame me because I was in weapons, but I was already there when he came in from the direction of the body. If I had killed Diana in security, Frank would’ve seen me coming from there — instead, I saw him come from there.

Alice, your logic is right: Frank had the path, the timing, and then immediately hard accused the only person who witnessed him leaving security. We have to get this right with 3 alive. Vote Frank.
